name: Gojiberry
description: Gojiberry lets agents read B2B lead signals, enriched lead data, and campaign results in the signed-in Gojiberry account. Each user signs in to their own Gojiberry account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which leads showed buying signals this week?
Summarize what Gojiberry knows about the leads from Acme.
How are my active campaigns performing on replies?

apps.name: Gojiberry
apps.description: Lead signal, enrichment, and campaign access, over Gojiberry's MCP server with browser sign-in.
